item.title: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss
item.description: Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
item.description: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
item.description: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
item.description: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Uber’s UK banking partner Griffin raises $20M for stablecoin services
item.description: The Series B valued Griffin at more than $100 million and will help fund stablecoin reserve services and onchain cross-border payments.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: EU DeFi proposals could push users to riskier platforms, says Coinbase exec
item.description: Coinbase’s EU policy chief says applying suitability tests beyond crypto lending and borrowing could limit access and fragment liquidity.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Stablecoin supply falls $14.2B in biggest 30-day drop since June 2022
item.description: Crypto markets were left with “less fuel” to rally after the market cap of major stablecoins saw its biggest 30-day drop in over four years.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Tron and Tether bring in Chainalysis after T3 crime unit folds
item.description: The group will focus on illicit USDT activity on Tron and help law enforcement investigate suspicious transfers and freeze funds faster.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Ethlabs drops Hegotá slot proposal in push for 2027 quantum readiness
item.description: Ethlabs’ roadmap aims to help Ethereum withstand quantum attacks and give users a way to protect their accounts by 2027.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows rose to nearly $300 million on Wednesday, up from $95 million a day earlier, as five-session withdrawals reached $1.44 billion.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: South Korea to permit crypto withdrawal freezes during hacking threats
item.description: The move follows recent security incidents involving South Korean crypto exchanges, including GOPAX’s precautionary suspension of services and a $70,000 hot-wallet breach at Prabang.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
item.description: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: MSCI confirms Strategy’s removal from indexes at end of November
item.description: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi are marked for deletion in MSCI’s final list, with changes taking effect after the Nov. 30 close.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Suiet wallet to shut down in latest exit from Sui ecosystem
item.description: The self-custodial wallet will keep its API services running through Nov. 14. Sui’s DeFi total value locked has fallen more than 22% over the past month.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after affairs: WSJ
item.description: The report about Huang’s possible departure came after the New York Times reported that he had a second extramarital affair.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Uncalled US House races could send more crypto allies to Congress
item.description: The remaining races feature pro-crypto candidates and others without a stated position, giving advocacy groups what they see as “an opportunity” for outreach.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro

item.title: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg
item.description: The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
item.description: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Jona Jaupi

item.title: OKXICE moves ahead with tokenized stocks as blue chips push back
item.description: The Nov. 23 debut puts a new SEC exemption to the test as Nasdaq pursues its own tokenized stock plans after warning that trading across platforms could fragment liquidity.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound
item.description: Bitcoin traded in a narrow range as investors bought the dip in tech stocks and US bond yields climbed on high CPI inflation data.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
item.description: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
item.description: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Christina Comben

item.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
item.description: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Korbinian Kettnaker

item.title: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
item.description: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: FSB urges Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
item.description: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September
item.description: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings
item.description: Barclays reported a $187 million stake as of Sept. 30, while Citigroup disclosed a new $119 million position in Fidelity’s Bitcoin ETF.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Kraken parent adds over 200 tokenized UK and EU stocks to xStocks
item.description: The expansion adds more than 200 tokenized UK and EU equities, including all 40 companies in Germany’s DAX index, as xStocks plans further expansion into Hong Kong.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Bitcoin short-term holders send 47K BTC to exchanges at a loss
item.description: Bitcoin fell to an 11-week low of $72,670 after slipping below short-term holders’ average cost basis of about $75,700, according to CryptoQuant.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg
